**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Remove the premature consumer readiness claim**

Calling OpenPlanner PR3 “existing ready” contradicts the card’s `incoming` status and the later requirement for planning qualification followed by lawful Ready/Todo/IP transitions. During planning or handoff, this can be read as readiness transferring from the completed source work even though the consumer has not qualified; remove “ready” or explicitly distinguish a separate GitHub PR state.
